Indicators per period (e.g. decade) and cell

Source: R/temporal.R
calc_period_indicators.Rd

Runs the year-filtered live tile SQL once per period and returns n, sp and es per cell and period. Periods are [start, start + width - 1].

Usage

calc_period_indicators(
  con,
  res = 2L,
  eov = NULL,
  aphiaid = NULL,
  taxon = NULL,
  starts = seq(1960L, 2020L, by = 10L),
  width = 10L,
  esn = 50L
)

Arguments

con

connection from obis_store_connect().

res

H3 resolution (coarse, e.g. 2-3, is sensible: the denominator thins quickly when records are split by decade).

eov

optional EOV name (one); see obis_eov_seeds().

aphiaid

optional WoRMS AphiaID(s) — the subtree filter.

taxon

optional named list of DwC rank values; see obis_h3t_sql().

starts

period start years (default decades 1960-2020).

width

period width in years (default 10).

esn

expected sample size for ES(n); default 50.

Value

data frame with period, cell, n, sp, es.
